text:
anya: Quick round of UX nits on the embeddings / rerank panel I mocked up — trying to catch accessibility and export edge cases before dev handoff. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/s/embeds-flow.png

matt: thanks — looks nice. main things i noticed: table feels dense on mobile, and the relevance column has too many decimal places. can we round? :eyes:

sara: +1 on rounding. also the export currently maps 'score' -> 'relevance_score' in CSV, which broke a demo i did. can we align headers with the UI labels?

anya: good call. proposal: show scores in UI as percent with 1 decimal (e.g., 87.3%), but export raw float in CSV (0.873). add a column header hint — hover tooltip that says "Export contains raw model scores". thoughts?

oliver: sounds reasonable. tiny a11y nit: the relevance column's color ramp fails 3:1 contrast on light mode for low scores. can we add a low-contrast pattern or an icon to supplement color?

anya: hmm pattern could be messy in the tiny cell. what about adding a >=20% opacity background plus a subtle dot icon when <30%? that keeps visual parity and gives non-color cue.

matt: +1 to icon. also keyboard nav: tab order currently jumps from batch input to the table header — users expect focus to go to the first row action button. can we ensure focusable elements are row-first?

sara: re: batch upload — what should the error state show if one row fails parsing? current mock just shows a generic "some rows failed" toast. need inline indicators and the ability to download failed-rows.csv.

anya: agree. sketching flow: after upload, show a "Parsing results" drawer listing successes/failures with row numbers, a small sample of the vector (truncated), and a download button for failures. button label: "Download failed rows (CSV)"

ux-research: quick note from testing: users want a lightweight preview of vectors that doesn't overwhelm them — collapse by default, show first 5 dims, and allow "Show full vector" to expand. also prefer code-style monospace for numbers for readability.

oliver: accessibility followup — make sure the expand/collapse has aria-expanded on the trigger and that the expanded content is announced. add sr-only text for the vector length: "vector length: 1536 dims"

anya: copy tweaks needed: current CTA "Export Vectors" is ambiguous. propose "Export raw vectors (CSV)" and a secondary "Export human-readable report (JSON)" for the rerank debug pack.

matt: can we rename the table column "Relevance" -> "Relevance (model)" and add a separate "User relevance" column if we accept manual adjustments later? keeps exported headers explicit.

sara: layout debate: should the preview grid be inline in the right rail or a modal? Inline keeps context, modal gives more room. mobile we definitely need modal.

anya: plan: inline on desktop with a collapsible right rail, modal on <=640px. will add responsive spec.

ux-research: one more testable hypothesis: show distribution sparkline for relevance at the top of the table to help users pick thresholds. could be a tiny 100px sparkline with keyboard-accessible tooltip.

anya: thanks all — i'll update the mock and push a new figma with notes: export header mapping, aria attributes, focus order, failed-rows download, and copy suggestions. ping me if you see anything else before EOD. :memo:
